mapper.select: SELECT ANY_VALUE(reviews_id) AS reviews_id, product_id, ANY_VALUE(rating) AS rating, content, ANY_VALUE(created_at) AS created_at FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY content ORDER BY reviews_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (product_id, rating, content, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{rating}, #{content}, now())
